atha paramarahasyo@yaṃ cakrāṇāṃ bhaṇyate@bhyudayaḥ // 1b ityayatnajamākhyātaṃ yatnajaṃ tu nigadyate / bījapiṇḍātmakaṃ sarvaṃ saṃvidaḥ spandanātmatām vidadhatparasaṃvittāvupāya iti varṇitam / yathāraghaṭṭacakrāgraghaṭīyantraughavāhanam ekānusaṃdhiyatnena citraṃ yantrodayaṃ bhajet / ekānusaṃdhānabalājjāte mantrodaye@niśam tanmantradevatā yatnāttādātmyena prasīdati / khe rasaikākṣi nityotthe tadardhaṃ dvikapiṇḍake trike sapta sahasrāṇi dviśatītyudayo mataḥ / catuṣke tu sahasrāṇi pañca caiva catuḥśatī pañcārṇe@bdhisahasrāṇi triśatī viṃśatistathā / ṣaṭke sahasratritayaṃ ṣaṭśatī codayo bhavet saptake trisahasraṃ tu ṣaḍaśītyadhikaṃ smṛtam / śataistu saptaviṃśatyā varṇāṣṭakavikalpite caturviṃśatiśatyā tu navārṇeṣūdayo bhavet / adhiṣaṣṭyekaviṃśatyā śatānāṃ daśavarṇake ekānnaviṃśatiśataṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ śivārṇake / aṣṭādaśa śatāni syurudayo dvādaśārṇake

tal-a07-p02 · verses 7.11-7.20 · WITHHELD

trayodaśārṇe dvāṣaṣṭyā śatāni kila ṣoḍaśa / tricatvāriṃśatā pañcadaśeti bhuvanārṇake caturdaśaśatī khābdhiḥ syātpañcadaśavarṇake / trayodaśaśatī sārdhā ṣoḍaśārṇe tu kathyate śatadvādaśikā saptadaśārṇe saikasaptatiḥ / aṣṭādaśārṇe vijñeyā śatadvādaśikā budhaiḥ caturviṃśatisaṃkhyāke cakre navaśatī bhavet / saptaviṃśatisaṃkhyāte tūdayo@ṣṭaśatātmakaḥ dvātriṃśake mahācakre ṣaṭśatī pañcasaptatiḥ / dvicaturviṃśake cakre sārdhāṃ śatacatuṣṭayīm udayaṃ piṇḍayogajñaḥ piṇḍamantreṣu lakṣayet / catuṣpañcāśake cakre śatānāṃ tu catuṣṭayam saptatriṃśatsahārdhena triśatyaṣṭāṣṭake bhavet / ardhamardhatribhāgaśca ṣaṭṣaṣṭirdviśatī bhavet ekāśītipade cakre udayaḥ prāṇacāragaḥ / cakre tu ṣaṇṇavatyākhye sapādā dviśatī bhavet aṣṭottaraśate cakre dviśatastūdayo bhavet / krameṇetthamidaṃ cakraṃ ṣaṭkṛtvo dviguṇaṃ yadā tato@pi dviguṇe@ṣṭāṃśasyārdhamadhyardhamekakam / tato@pi sūkṣmakuśalairardhārdhādiprakalpane

tal-a07-p03 · verses 7.21-7.30 · WITHHELD

bhāgaṣoḍaśakasthityā sūkṣmaścāro@bhilakṣyate / evaṃ prayatnasaṃruddhaprāṇacārasya yoginaḥ krameṇa prāṇacārasya grāsa evopajāyate / prāṇagrāsakramāvāptakālasaṃkarṣaṇasthitiḥ saṃvidekaiva pūrṇā syājjñānabhedavyapohanāt / tathā hi prāṇacārasya navasyānudaye sati na kālabhedajanito jñānabhedaḥ prakalpate / saṃvedyabhedānna jñānaṃ bhinnaṃ śikharivṛttavat kālastu bhedakastasya sa tu sūkṣmaḥ kṣaṇo mataḥ / saukṣmyasya cāvadhirjñānaṃ yāvattiṣṭhati sa kṣaṇaḥ anyathā na sa nirvaktuṃ nipuṇairapi pāryate / jñānaṃ kiyadbhavettāvattadabhāvo na bhāsate tadabhāvaśca no tāvadyāvattatrākṣavartmani / arthe vātmapradeśe vā na saṃyogavibhāgitā sā cedudayate spandamayī tatprāṇagā dhruvam / bhavedeva tataḥ prāṇaspandābhāve na sā bhavet tadabhāvānna vijñānābhāvaḥ saivaṃ tu saiva dhīḥ / na cāsau vastuto dīrghā kālabhedavyapohanāt vastuto hyata eveyaṃ kālaṃ saṃvinna saṃspṛśet / ata ekaiva saṃvittirnānārūpe tathātathā

tal-a07-p04 · verses 7.31-7.40 · WITHHELD

vindānā nirvikalpāpi vikalpo bhāvagocare / spandāntaraṃ na yāvattaduditaṃ tāvadeva saḥ tāvāneko vikalpaḥ syādvividhaṃ vastu kalpayan / ye tvitthaṃ na vidusteṣāṃ vikalpo nopapadyate sa hyeko na bhavetkaścit trijagatyāpi jātucit / śabdārūṣaṇayā jñānaṃ vikalpaḥ kila kathyate sā ca syātkramikaivetthaṃ kiṃ kathaṃ ko vikalpayet / ghaṭa ityapi neyānsyādvikalpaḥ kā kathā sthitau na vikalpaśca ko@pyasti yo mātrāmātraniṣṭhitaḥ / na ca jñānasamūho@sti teṣāmayugapatsthiteḥ tenāstaṅgata evaiṣa vyavahāro vikalpajaḥ / tasmātspandāntaraṃ yāvannodiyāttāvadekakam vijñānaṃ tadvikalpātmadharmakoṭīrapi spṛśet / ekāśītipadodāraśaktyāmarśātmakastataḥ vikalpaḥ śivatādāyī pūrvameva nirūpitaḥ / yathā karṇau nartayāmītyevaṃ yatnāttathā bhavet cakracāragatādyatnāttadvattaccakragaiva dhīḥ / japahomārcanādīnāṃ prāṇasāmyamato vidhiḥ siddhāmate kuṇḍalinīśaktiḥ prāṇasamonmanā / uktaṃ ca yoginīkaule tadetatparameśinā

tal-a07-p05 · verses 7.41-7.50 · WITHHELD

padamantrākṣare cakre vibhāgaṃ śaktitattvagam / padeṣu kṛtvā mantrajño japādau phalabhāgbhavet dvitrisaptāṣṭasaṃkhyātaṃ lopayecchatikodayam / iti śaktisthitā mantrā vidyā vā cakranāyakāḥ padapiṇḍasvarūpeṇa jñātvā yojyāḥ sadā priye / nityodaye mahātattve udayasthe sadāśive ayuktāḥ śaktimārge tu na japtāścodayena ye / te na siddhyanti yatnena japtāḥ koṭiśatairapi mālāmantreṣu sarveṣu mānaso japa ucyate / upāṃśurvā śaktyudayaṃ teṣāṃ na parikalpayet padamantreṣu sarveṣu yāvattatpadaśaktigam / śakyate satataṃ yuktaistāvajjapyaṃ tu sādhakaiḥ tāvatī teṣu vai saṃkhyā padeṣu padasaṃjñitā / tāvantamudayaṃ kṛtvā tripadoktyāditaḥ kramāt dvādaśākhye dvādaśite cakre sārdhaṃ śataṃ bhavet / udayastaddhi sacatuścatvāriṃśacchataṃ bhavet ṣoḍaśākhye dvādaśite dvānavatyadhike śate / cārārdhena samaṃ proktaṃ śataṃ dvādaśakādhikam ṣoḍaśākhye ṣoḍaśite bhaveccaturaśītigaḥ / udayo dviśataṃ taddhi ṣaṭpañcāśatsamuttaram

cārāṣṭabhāgāṃstrīnatra kathayantyadhikānbudhāḥ / aṣṭāṣṭake dvādaśite pādārdhaṃ viṃśatiṃ vasūn udayaḥ saptaśatikā sāṣṭā ṣaṣṭiryato hi saḥ / eṣa cakrodayaḥ proktaḥ sādhakānāṃ hitāvahaḥ niruddhya mānasīrvṛttīścakre viśrāntimāgataḥ / vyutthāya yāvadviśrāmyettāvaccārodayo hyayam pūrṇe samudaye tvatra praveśaikātmyanirgamāḥ / traya ityata evoktaḥ siddhau madhyodayo varaḥ ādyantodayanirmuktā madhyamodayasaṃyutāḥ / mantravidyācakragaṇāḥ siddhibhājo bhavanti hi mantracakrodayajñastu vidyācakrodayārthavit / kṣipraṃ siddhyediti proktaṃ śrīmaddviṃśatike trike dvistriścaturvā mātrābhirvidyāṃ vā cakrameva vā / tattvodayayutaṃ nityaṃ pṛthagbhūtaṃ japetsadā piṇḍākṣarapadairmantramekaikaṃ śaktitattvagam / bahvakṣarastu yo mantro vidyā vā cakrameva vā śaktisthaṃ naiva taṃ tatra vibhāgastvoṃnamontagaḥ / asmiṃstattvodaye tasmādahorātrastriśastriśaḥ vibhajyate vibhāgaśca punareva triśastriśaḥ / pūrvodaye tu viśramya dvitīyenollasedyadā
